div.div:
① Shift the alias to the new Lambda version 10% → 10 minutes → 100%
② Roll back when an alarm fires
Amazon Inspector and AWS Security Hub are not enabled in the first pillar (dashed frame).
FPolicy events from FSx for ONTAP (NFS and SMB operations) are processed by Lambda through SQS and EventBridge. This figure shows only the Lambda deployment and does not include the FPolicy path.

div.div:
*1 What was checked
The template was checked. The alias shift and the alarm-triggered rollback in a real deployment have not been run and confirmed.
The 4 alarms watch the new version's errors, failed records and duration, and throttles (as written in the template).
